content: Butoconazole nitrate cream, commonly marketed under brand names such as Gynazole-1 and Mycelex, is an antifungal medication used to treat vaginal yeast infections. It works by reducing symptoms such as vaginal burning, itching, and abnormal discharge associated with this condition. This medication belongs to the azole class of antifungals. Administration Instructions: This medication is for vaginal use only. Wash your hands thoroughly before and after application. Avoid contact with the eyes. If accidental contact occurs, rinse the eyes immediately with plenty of water. Use the medication as directed by your physician, typically as a single dose. Follow all preparation and usage instructions provided in the product packaging. To apply, lie on your back with your knees bent toward your chest. Insert the applicator filled with the cream into the vagina as far as it comfortably goes. Do not use tampons or douches while undergoing treatment with this medication. If your symptoms do not improve or if they return within two months, consult your doctor. Special Considerations: Pregnant women in their second or third trimester may require extended use of up to six days. However, the safety and efficacy of this medication during pregnancy have not been fully established. Use during pregnancy should only occur if clearly needed, and the risks and benefits should be discussed with your healthcare provider. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk. Use caution if breastfeeding. The product contains mineral oil, which can weaken latex or rubber products such as condoms, diaphragms, or cervical caps. Avoid using these products during treatment and for three days after completing treatment to prevent failure and unintended pregnancy. If you experience recurrent or difficult-to-treat yeast infections, consider being evaluated for potential underlying conditions, such as HIV infection. Contraindications: Do not use this medication if you are allergic to butoconazole or other azole antifungal agents (e.g., clotrimazole, fluconazole). Avoid use during the first trimester of pregnancy. Do not use this medication if you have symptoms such as fever, chills, flu-like symptoms, abdominal pain, or foul-smelling vaginal discharge, as these may indicate a more serious condition requiring different treatment. Side Effects: Common side effects may include increased vaginal or urethral burning, itching, or pain, as well as mild abdominal cramps. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare but may occur. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience symptoms such as rash, itching/swelling (especially of the face/tongue/throat), severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing. This is not a comprehensive list of side effects. Contact your doctor for medical advice if you experience any unusual or bothersome symptoms. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of this medication or increase the risk of side effects. Keep a list of all medications and supplements you are taking and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Consult your healthcare provider for more information. Overdose: If swallowed, this medication may be harmful. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center immediately. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Storage and Disposal: Store the medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Prevention of Vaginal Yeast Infections: To reduce the risk of recurrent infections, thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for prolonged periods. Important Notes: This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. Do not use it for other infections unless directed by your doctor. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
